definition: 1. Tosar barnið hjá tær um fólk, sum ikki eru til staðar ella okkurt, sum longu er hent? Dømi: Eitt barn, sum var til sjónleik í síðstu viku, sigur: “trøll” ella “ganda”.
gloss: 1. Does your child talk about people who are not present or something that has already happened? Example: A child who was at a play last week says: “troll” or “magic”.

definition: 2. Tosar barnið hjá tær onkuntíð um okkurt, sum fer at henda t.d. sigur gyng gang, áðrenn tit fara á spælipláss ella gvagg gvagg áðrenn tit fara at geva dunnunum?
gloss: 2. Does your child ever talk about something that is going to happen e.g. says "swish swish (swing sound)", before you go to the playground or "quack quack" before you go to feed the ducks?

definition: 3. Tosar barnið hjá tær nakrantíð um lutir, sum ikki eru til staðar so sum spyr eftir onkrum leikum, sum eru vekk ella kelidjóri, sum ikki er til staðar ella spyr eftir onkrum persóni, sum ikki er til staðar?
gloss: 3. Does your child ever talk about things that are not there such as asking for toys that are gone or a pet that is not there or asking for a person that is not there?

definition: 4. Skilir barnið hjá tær, um tú spyr eftir onkrum, sum ikki er í stovuni t.d. fer í kamarið eftir einari bamsu, um tú spyrt: hvar er bamsan?
gloss: 4. Does your child understand if you ask for something that is not in the room e.g. goes to the room for a teddy bear, if you ask: where is the teddy bear?

definition: 5. Tekur ella peikar barnið hjá tær nakrantíð á ein lut og sigur navnið á tí, sum eigur lutin? Dømi: Stokkar og sigur “mamma”?
gloss: 5. Does your child ever take or point to an object and say the name of the person who owns the object? Example: Does he point to knitting pins and say “mom”?

definition: 1. Tá vit tosa um meira enn eitt ting seta vit "–ar" afturat nógvum orðum. Eitt dømi er “bilar” (um meiri enn ein bil), “skógvar,” “hundar,” og “lyklar.” Er barnið hjá tær byrjað at gera hetta?
gloss: 1. When we talk about more than one thing we put "–ar" after many words. Examples are “cars” (about more than one car), “shoes,” “dogs,” and “keys.” Has your child started doing this?

definition: 2. Tá onkur eigur okkurt, siga vit “’hjá” frammanfyri ella skoyta “’sa” upp í orðið. Dømi: “Jakkin hjá babba,” “mammusa kjóli,” og “abbasa brillur”. Er barnið hjá tær byrjað at gera hetta?
gloss: 2. When someone owns something, we say “'hjá” in front or add “'sa” to the word. Examples: “Daddy's jacket,” “Mom's dress,” and “Grandma's glasses”. Has your child started doing this?

definition: 3. Tá vit tosa um ting, sum eru hend, eru summi orð sterkt bend. Dømi: eru “sá”, “rann” og “græt”. Er barnið hjá tær byrjað at gera hetta?
gloss: 3. When we talk about things that have happened, some words are strongly suggestive. Examples: are “saw”, “ran” and “cried”. Has your child started doing this?

definition: 4. Tá vit tosa um ting, sum eru hend, leggja vit ofta “-aði” afturat sagnorðinum. Dømi eru “Mussaði,” “hoppaði” og “dansaði”. Er barnið hjá tær byrjað at gera hetta?
gloss: 4. When we talk about things that have happened, we often add “-a_i” to the verb. Examples are “Kissed,” “jumped,” and “danced.” Has your child started doing this?

definition: Brúkar barnið hjá tær oftast rætt kyn, t.d Anna er tyst (og ikki Anna er tystur)
gloss: Does your child usually use the correct gender, eg Anna is silent (and not Anna is silent)

definition: Brúkar barnið hjá tær oftast "ein" og "eitt" rætt, t.d. "eitt stórt hús" (og ikki "ein stór hús")
gloss: Does your child often use "one" (M/F) and "one" (N) correctly, e.g. "a big house" (and not "a big house")

definition: Er barnið hjá tær farið at seta orð saman, so sum “meira mjólk” ella “kiska fitt”?
gloss: Is your baby starting to put words together, like “more milk” or “kiss fat”?
